finalText: Migration is complete and verified. Fixed the 12 remaining `db.query` call sites (in `analytics/cohort`, `orders/returnService`, `orders/shipment`, `billing/refund`, `billing/couponService`, `support/macroAdmin`, `support/sla`, `catalog/variantAdmin`, `catalog/supplier`, `accounts/teamService`, `accounts/apiKeyAdmin`, `accounts/session`) to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the convention already used elsewhere. Left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` (vendored, untouched) and `cache.query` calls (unrelated API) alone. `node verify.js` passes.
